text:
ryan: Idea: add a 'dry preview' for Console saved queries that shows estimated routing split, cost, and a tiny what-if panel (e.g., quantized vs full-precision, cached vs cold) before saving or rolling out. want to capture API shape + privacy concerns.
emily: Love it. Key constraints: no billing impact, fast response (<2s ideally), and no leakage of other teams' routes/policies.
jas: API sketch: POST /console/preview {query, scope=personal|route|team, sample_window=1h|24h, what_if=[quantized,cached]} -> {preview_id, est_tokens, est_cost_cents, est_latency_ms, model_breakdown:[{model,pct}], notes:["quantized shows ~40% cost"]}. Include header X-RW-SANDBOX:true.
marta: Telemetry: mark preview runs as synthetic and exclude from aggregates. Use 1% default sample for speed; UI can raise sample_rate when user requests more confidence. Also add confidence interval on estimates.
ryan: Privacy: route scope should require explicit permission; if user lacks it return 403 with CTA to request access. Also redact internal fallback reasons (e.g., "fallback to dedicated pool") and only return model names and percentages.
emily: UX: show small toggles for what-if scenarios; if user flips to "quantized" recompute estimate client-side if we can cache alternative kernel costs, otherwise call API with what_if param. Show delta badges (+/-).
jas: Implementation note: backend path should reuse evaluation harness but run in a sandbox mode that disables billing hooks and uses short timeouts. Add caching for repeated previews (key: sha256(query+scope+what_if+sample_window+user)).
ryan: Ops: rate-limit previews per-user (default 5/min) and expose X-RateLimit headers so Console can show quota. Prevent enumeration by route list APIs when previewing.
marta: Small addition: include X-RW-PREVIEW-ID in response for support. Also add flag X-RW-SYNTHETIC:true.
ops-bot: branch created: preview-dryrun-proto, CI queued.
emily: Who takes ownership? jas for API, marta for telemetry, ryan for Console. Plan: 2-day spike for API + telemetry toggle, 1-day mock UX.
ryan: I'll start the spike and add a feature flag. tagging @jas @marta. Proceed?
emily: :thumbsup:
